## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete user trigger and what changes. Include a small before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List relevant commands/results and actual browser/device/runtime checks. Distinguish mocks, skipped/unrun gates and hosted CI from local checks. Documentation-only changes should identify factual/link checks.

## Review

- [ ] Original take data/identity and recovery behavior are preserved.
- [ ] Contract/privacy/dependency changes are described with coordinated consumers and relevant tests.
- [ ] Logs/fixtures contain no credentials, private recordings or unapproved third-party assets.
- [ ] Remaining limits and release-checklist implications are stated.

A PR does not authorize publication or waive pending contributor/license/vendor/device gates.
